sources.title: Farmer's Market on Main Street in Dyersburg, TN

🌽 There’s nothing like a Saturday morning at the Main Street Dyersburg Farmers Market! 🍑☀️

Fresh-picked produce, local honey, homemade baked goods, handcrafted gifts, live music, Storytime, and some of the best local vendors around—there’s something for everyone!

📍Find us at 334 Clark Ave., right beside the splash pad and playground, and just a short walk from the historic Downtown Dyersburg Square. Make a morning of it—shop the market, let the kids play, and explore downtown!

🛍️ Market Hours:
🌞 Saturdays: 8:00 AM–12:00 PM (closing time may be earlier due to heat index)
🌽 Tuesdays: 7:00 AM–11:00 AM (perfect for grabbing fresh produce before work!)

Come see why the Farmers Market is one of Dyersburg’s favorite places to gather. We can’t wait to welcome you! 💚
